budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Cooperatively deliver the six finite fruits. Each delivery rewards every courier 0.5; the delivering courier additionally receives 0.5 when its private preferred species matches.
task.natural_termination: Six deliveries naturally complete the garden. Missing pollen or poor coordination may instead reach the 96-step truncation.
task.interaction: A packet must pass to another handler before grafting. Grafting closes that plant as a pollen source, then opens a delayed harvest opportunity for any courier. One inventory slot and contested plants create route, handoff and harvesting tradeoffs.
task.observation_access: Each role sees its own preference and inventory. Courier/plant/active-fruit payloads are visible only at Manhattan distance <=3; other payloads are zero with explicit visibility bits. Depot, clock, phase, aggregate stock-consumption counters and anonymous event-count bells are public. Preferences of other roles are never exposed in observations or entity attributes.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Public garden bell: count of pollen packets gathered this transition
Public garden bell: count of successful courier handoffs this transition
Public garden bell: count of plants grafted this transition
Public garden bell: count of fruits becoming ripe this transition
Public garden bell: count of fruits harvested this transition
Public garden bell: count of fruit deliveries this transition
Public garden bell: count of blocked movement proposals due to couriers
Total pollen units consumed by grafting

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
